entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to make a return. I just feel so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely help you with the return process. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling. Order number VF77891. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this has just been a bit of a letdown.

Thank you, Mark. I see your account here and I appreciate your loyalty with us. I'm looking at the order for the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the wrong size. I waited to try it on, and it's just... far too tight. I can't even move comfortably in it. I feel bad about it, I was really looking forward to wearing it and I really needed this money for something else if it didn't work out.

Oh, I completely understand. Getting the fit just right is the most important part. Let me just check the purchase date... okay, I see it was delivered 31 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window for a return.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a relief.
Absolutely. I can process this for you right now. Would you prefer a full refund back to your original payment method, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
As much as I love the jersey, I think I just need the refund right now. Is that okay?

That is perfectly fine, Mark. I've just initiated that for you. And because you're one of our long-time VIP customers, I've also waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
Wow, really? That's... thank you, Sarah. That really helps a lot. You've made this much less stressful.
It's my pleasure. We value your business and want to make sure you're taken care of. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome, Mark. Have a wonderful rest of your day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
